notes.subject: save bilong bel
notes.rationale: חכמת לב 'wisdom of heart' → 'save bilong bel' (bel = לב, not hat)

notes.subject: חרש וחשב
notes.rationale: craftsman vs designer: participles rendered as two kinds of workmen, following KJV/JPS 'engraver and cunning workman'

notes.subject: kula red bilong ol binatang
notes.rationale: תולעת השני literally 'worm/crimson insect'; shape kept rather than plain 'scarlet'

translation: Em i pulimapim ⟨את⟩ ol wantaim save bilong bel, bilong wokim olgeta kain wok bilong man i save wokim ol samting, na bilong man i save tingim desen, na bilong man i save kilim kala wantaim nin, long blu, long pes, long kula red bilong ol binatang, na long gutpela linen, na bilong man i save tanim tret; ol man i wokim olgeta wok, na ol man i save tingim ol desen.
